correctness.rationale: For each energy-w Fourier sector of the cube adjacency, a state is dark exactly when it vanishes at all positive sink sites. The restricted Walsh matrix is row-equivalent to stacked subset-inclusion matrices. Gottlieb maximal rank and a lower-row span identity give rank C(d,min(r,w,d-w)). Summation yields the exact bright/dark dimension, Catalan near-threshold cases, complete-absorption threshold, fixed-radius asymptotic and rate independence. Every step and boundary r>=2, d>=6 is given in RESULT.md; the self-contained exact checker returned VERIFY_OK checks=759. Tests do not replace proof.
